==Notes==
*Similarly to other creatures constructed of ice in the game, they are weak against fire damage. However unlike other creatures constructed of ice, they do not have additional armor against cold damage.
*Deals [[cold damage]] melee attacks.
*Their Frozen Burst will also hex nearby [[Stone Elemental]] but not damage them.
